g.title: public.job_alerts
g.text: What the watchdog told the owners about a job: late, failing, stuck (started and never finished), or recovered. Append-only.
The pg_net request that emailed the owners directly through Resend (null: not set up, or no owners).

g.title: public.job_status
g.text: One row per scheduled job: how often it should run, and how its latest runs went (every run, quiet ones included). The watchdog reads it. Written by job_start() and job_finish(); never deleted.
How often the timetable runs it. The watchdog calls it late after three intervals with no success.
When the owners were alerted about the current incident (null: none open). Cleared, with a "recovered" alert, when it's fixed.

g.title: public.job_alerts:job->public.job_status:job
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (job) REFERENCES job_status(job) ON DELETE RESTRICT

g.title: public.admin_notifications
g.text: The admin bell, one row per team member's login: problem reports and replies, requests, team changes, alerts for the owners, and (listing_submitted) an Experience waiting for review, for everyone who can review it. Each admin reads and marks read only their own. Ids only: published to Realtime. Deleted with the admin's login, and a listing_submitted row with its listing.
For a team change: the admin_actions row saying who did what (invite, role change, removal, second factor reset, join).
For a request: the request (request_new to each owner; request_decided to the person who asked).
For a job alert: what the watchdog found.
For listing_submitted: the listing sent for review. Deleted with it.

g.title: public.admin_notifications:job_alert_id->public.job_alerts:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (job_alert_id) REFERENCES job_alerts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

g.title: public.admin_emails
g.text: The team's email outbox (admin roles, 2026-10-19): an invitation to the person invited (admin_invite), and each team change to every active owner (admin_team_change), their own included. Never a reason or note. Only its delivery details change (outbox_guard); never deleted. The server sends it; the owner reads it.
For a job alert email: what the watchdog found (admin_action_id is empty then).
For admin_listing_submitted: the listing sent for review. No key: the outbox row is kept if the listing is deleted (the email is then skipped).

g.title: public.admin_emails:job_alert_id->public.job_alerts:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (job_alert_id) REFERENCES job_alerts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
